craft_notes: Sthāyin: raudra-vīra of the cremation ground — Rauhine register throughout: broken-middle-drunk → gore teaches → brow burns → sky speaks → parted freed. Though-shaped + every-letters-opening; api concessive per UNC. Rejected: (a) though→yet → killed concessive exact. Read aloud: BHAI-ra-va-SHAPED though … TURN the-WORLD with-IN.

lines: Bhairava-shaped though — rosary in hand held —
so by every letter's opening, turn the world within.
l4.sanskrit_cite: bhairavarūpo 'py asi yat tatrāpi kare 'kṣamālikāṃ dhatse tat sarvākṣavikāsād viśvaṃ parivartayasy antaḥ

reads_against.argmap: How turn the world by letters? → Rosary-held turns world by letters within.
c1_essence: Egg-middled saps drunk; shown within as-if.
Rosary held turns world within by letters.
Bubbles jar; brow-eye burning taught supreme-fire.
Aimed inward expanding shows unstained self all-states.
Sky-clad speaks bare; veil questioned covering.
Destroyer shown gleaming-bodied from dark ground.
